يبتهل (form VIII)
# يَبْتَهِلُ (yabtahilu) /jab.ta.hi.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَهَلَ (ibtahala)
# يَبْتَهِلَ (yabtahila) /jab.ta.hi.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَهَلَ (ibtahala)
# يَبْتَهِلْ (yabtahil) /jab.ta.hil/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِبْتَهَلَ (ibtahala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
